name: Islamnashaat Translation Toolkit
author: islamnashaat02

sections.description:
Islamnashaat Translation Toolkit adds an administrator translation workflow for WPML sites. Select source content and a target language, translate supported text with MyMemory or Chrome’s optional on-device Translator, review the result and save it.

Features:

  • Pages, posts, public post types, taxonomies and Elementor templates.
  • Review existing translated posts and registered strings before updating them.
  • ACF Theme Settings for registered options pages using standard options storage.
  • ACF text, textarea and WYSIWYG fields, including supported group, repeater and flexible-content children.
  • Fields marked Copy or Ignore are excluded; URLs, media and non-text fields are preserved.
  • Confirmation before sending content for translation and separate optional email-sharing consent.
  • No plugin subscription or WPML translation credits required. Provider limits still apply.

Requires WPML Multilingual CMS. The Strings workflow additionally requires WPML String Translation. ACF Theme Settings requires ACF PRO with registered options pages and ACF Multilingual (ACFML). These third-party plugins are not included.

This plugin is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WPML, OnTheGoSystems, Advanced Custom Fields, Google or Translated.

Supported text fields are saved directly to the WPML-linked target. Review content on a staging site before using it on a live site. Existing target repeater row order and layouts must match the source. Custom ACF options storage IDs, clone fields and arbitrary custom Elementor widgets are not supported. On the first save of a nested ACF field, its source structure and non-text values initialize that target field. Existing target values are preserved except for submitted text.

External services

All plugin JavaScript and CSS files are bundled in this plugin. jQuery and Dashicons are loaded from WordPress core. No remote JavaScript, PHP, CSS, fonts, images or iframes are loaded by the plugin. The server-side HTTP requests below exchange service data only; API response content is never executed as code. No account registration or API key is required for MyMemory’s documented free endpoint or the optional consent-recording endpoint. Chrome uses its browser-provided API.

MyMemory (Translated)

When an administrator selects MyMemory and confirms a translation, WordPress sends the selected text, source language, target language and optional contact email to https://api.mymemory.translated.net/get. The email may qualify for the provider’s contact-email allowance. Leaving the email empty still allows translation within provider limits. Content is processed according to MyMemory’s terms; only submit content you are authorized to share. The site server IP and normal connection metadata are also visible to the service. No automatic translation requests are made from public-facing pages.

Documentation: https://mymemory.translated.net/doc/spec.php
Usage limits: https://mymemory.translated.net/doc/usagelimits.php
Terms: https://mymemory.translated.net/terms-and-conditions
Privacy: https://translated.com/confidentiality

Optional email sharing with Islamnashaat Translation Toolkit

Only after an administrator selects the unchecked-by-default consent box and clicks Share email with Islamnashaat Translation Toolkit, the plugin sends the email, consent timestamp, plugin version, privacy-policy version and source label to the developer’s Google Apps Script endpoint at script.google.com. It sends no translation content or site URL in this payload. The endpoint and its hosting provider can see ordinary connection metadata, including the site server IP. The endpoint may redirect to script.googleusercontent.com or a Google-managed googleusercontent.com subdomain to return its JSON response. WordPress’s safe HTTP API validates redirects. No file or response is included, evaluated or executed.

Endpoint: https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwtXr3AxTFMkgws41OPnHsf7q1_aYez8Gta8e2IPvYdc7x4bQ276SWPuuFn60j0N0-z/exec

This endpoint records explicit consent and an optional usage-measurement email. It is independent of the translation service, and no account is needed to use it. The developer’s privacy page may refer to the previous product name, IN Auto Translate.

The published developer policy describes usage measurement, no marketing and retention of up to 24 months in a private Google Sheet. The plugin does not administer that remote storage or delete its records on uninstall. Review the policy for the controller’s contact and deletion process. This optional sharing is separate from sending an email directly to MyMemory during translation and is not required to use the plugin.

Developer privacy policy: https://islamnashaat03.github.io/IN-Auto-Translate/privacy.html
Google privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
Google terms: https://policies.google.com/terms

Chrome on-device Translator

When selected on a supported desktop browser, the plugin calls the browser’s built-in Translator API. Chrome may download language models from Google. Translation text is processed locally by that API; it is not sent to MyMemory or to the developer’s email endpoint. Availability depends on the browser, device, languages and a secure context.

Documentation: https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/translator-api
Google privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
Google terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Install and configure WPML and any optional dependencies required by your workflow.
  2. Deactivate any older or personal edition of Islamnashaat Translation Toolkit.
  3. Upload this ZIP using Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  4. Open Islamnashaat Translation Toolkit. Choose a translation engine and read its service disclosure.
  5. Choose source content and target language, prepare, translate, review and save.
  6. For ACF Theme Settings, save the source options first and set the relevant ACFML text-field preferences to Translate.
sections.faq:
Does this include WPML or ACF PRO?

No. Obtain and activate these plugins separately using your own licenses.

Does it include the personal edition’s Google Experimental engine?

No. This release includes MyMemory and Chrome on-device translation.

Is sharing my email with the developer required?

No. The optional developer consent checkbox starts unchecked. A MyMemory contact email, if entered, is sent to MyMemory with translation requests independently of that checkbox.

Can I edit an existing translation?

Yes. Prepare the content or ACF options, or load registered strings, review saved text, make changes and save again. Source text is not overwritten.

Are all ACF and Elementor field types supported?

No. Only supported textual values are exposed. Check the limitations in the description and verify front-end output before production use.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Updated the MyMemory terms and Translated privacy links to their current public URLs.

1.1.1

  • Adopted a distinctive public name and matching slug/text domain.
  • Corrected the WordPress.org contributor and author profile.
  • Clarified external JSON services, consent, hostnames and account requirements.
  • Fixed the edition-conflict guard so normal activation registers the admin page and AJAX handlers.

1.1.0

  • Added a dedicated ACF Theme Settings translation workflow with language-scoped reads and writes.
  • Made translation engine and email controls accessible from every workflow.
  • Added existing-translation review and corrected mixed-language string translation.
  • Prevented same-language taxonomy writes and invalid post payloads from creating translations.
  • Preserved backslashes and protected URLs, placeholders and shortcodes while translating text.
  • Added conflict handling when another edition is active.
  • Removed the unofficial Google Experimental engine from the distribution build.
  • Updated public slug, service disclosures and package metadata.

1.0.5

  • Updated naming, AJAX nonce validation and safe HTTP handling.

1.0.4

  • Hardened WPML String Translation database queries.
